|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">代表的な地雷敷設／爆破用装甲ドロイド。軍事目的に転用された。地雷や爆薬を仕掛けたり除去したりする。このＬＩＮ－Ｖ８Ｋはジャワに再改造されたもの。</span><ref name="jp1-face" />
|translation='''English reading aid (AI translation)'''

'''Lore:''' A typical armored droid for laying mines and demolition, adapted for military use. It lays and removes mines and explosives. This LIN-V8K has been modified again by Jawas.<ref name="jp1-face" />

'''Game text:''' Can lay mines. Also, at any time during a turn, may use 1 Force to ‘disable’ (lose) one mine at the same location card.<ref name="jp1-face" />
